other_failure_modes.name: Unadjusted ensemble weights on model failure
other_failure_modes.description: If a model fails during the final fit/predict phase, its weight is skipped without redistributing it to successful models. Because the weights are pre-normalized to sum to 1, skipping a model causes the final predictions to be scaled down by the missing weight, severely underestimating the target.

summary: The agent provides a structurally sound pipeline with proper train/validation splitting, appropriate regression models, and leakage-free imputation via sklearn Pipelines. However, it completely lacks feature engineering (FM07) and relies on a single evaluation metric and split (FM14, FM15). Critically, there is a severe execution logic flaw in the final ensembling step where exceptions during model prediction cause the ensemble weights to silently drop without redistribution, leading to artificially deflated predictions if any model fails.
